senses.gloss: जु जु, see जू and छ्यु.

जू जू, ii. 9, जुना, नी, Par. (in the native collection of roots, जु, i. 1, Ātm.),
 1. To push on (ved.).
 2. To impel.
 --With the prep. प्र प्र, To push on, to impel.
 --Ptcple. pf. pass. प्रजवित, Rām. 3, 33, 27; Hariv. 10848.
 --Cf. probably Lat. gavi in gaudeo, gavisus sum; γηθέω, ἀγαυός.
